1. may-a, a. (ī) sx. [formation, make: 🞄√ mi, weak form of √ mā, form], formed, 🞄made, or consisting of, full of;
 m. N. of an 🞄Asura (a skilled artificer, magician, teacher 🞄of astronomy and the art of war).
mayya, m. N. of a Brāhman.
mā-ya, a. creating illusions (Viṣṇu): 🞄-vat, a. magical (metr. for māyā-).
maya-grāma, m. N. of a village.
may-ú, m. Kiṃnara or kind of animal 🞄resembling man.

māyo-bhava, m. well-being, gladness;
 🞄-bhavya, n. id..
